latest.title: Updates for July 11, 2026
latest.body:
- Fix slow Docker web builds during static page generation
- Auto-join dashboard users to official Discord via guilds.join
- Add guild economy system synced with dashboard
- Declutter the marketing site navigation bar
- Fix Dokploy web build failures for changelog deploys
- Allow .git in Docker build context for release generation
- Fix Discord #changelogs not updating on Dokploy deploys
- Replace yt-dlp YouTube playback with SoundCloud streaming
- Fix music playback by using standalone yt-dlp binaries

releases.title: Updates for July 9, 2026
releases.body:
- Polish marketing site motion with scroll reveals and fluid hover
- Fix Docker web build when Discord client ID is missing at build time
- Add Puter as free OpenAI gateway for ChatGPT and TTS
- Make ChatGPT and TTS production-ready for Discord
- Add Mintlify-style /docs site for Deelo setup guides
- Make changelog sync day-aware for daily release bundles

releases.title: Updates for July 7, 2026
releases.body:
- Overhaul dashboard with module toggles and a sleeker control-center UI
- Remove personal username from homepage command preview demo
- Add DB-backed timers and multi-message welcome/goodbye commands
- Finish five partially built bot features: aliases, clownboard, logs, Pinterest, bump reminders
- Fix pricing redeem CTA looping back to pricing instead of redeem flow
- Add launch-day SEO, UX, and dashboard polish for production readiness
- Fix broken mobile menu X showing on desktop widths
- Show hamburger nav only on mobile viewports
- Fix mobile nav hamburger blocked by What's New modal
- Edit Discord changelog embeds when git release content updates
- Fix suggestions page modal, search field, and error handling
- Improve Discord OAuth diagnostics and error mapping
